coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 11 ground-truth variable items at a conceptual level (27%): ZB-2p scheduling with an ideal comparator, ideal-versus-actual execution comparison, and bubble-rate measurement.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output replaces the fixed 16-stage, 64-microbatch experiment with a variable stage/microbatch grid and additional scheduling baselines. It omits the specified 14.6B model configuration, exact zero-bubble settings, and Nsight/export/SVG profiling workflow. It does not use the specified complete-communication-overlap theoretical reference or explicitly measure samples-per-second-per-GPU throughput and computed-versus-profiled timeline alignment. Its bubble formulas and strict zero/floor-based criteria also differ from the intended evaluation.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the expected conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing the expectation of near-zero bubbles, generally below 1%, with small real-execution overheads and supporting evidence from high throughput and tight theoretical/profiled timeline alignment.
